scope.subject: Example stationery storefront control audit (synthetic)
limitations: Training example. The storefront, evidence and owner statement are fictional. Internal records were outside the authorized scope.

evidence.observation: The owner says dormant support tickets are deleted after 90 days.
A partial text capture refers to a script named metrics.js. No runtime activity was captured.
The name in E-script suggests that the storefront may collect usage metrics.

findings.title: Support inbox access
findings.observation: The roles with access to the support inbox are unknown.
findings.applicability_reason: The support workflow requires internal confirmation.

findings.title: Deletion of dormant tickets
findings.observation: The owner supplied a retention period. The actual deletion process remains unverified.
findings.applicability_reason: The period and system it applies to require confirmation.

findings.title: Possible usage metrics
findings.observation: The script name suggests metrics collection. Any processing or transfer remains unverified.
findings.applicability_reason: The check depends on the data actually processed.

actions.summary: Request a redacted support inbox role matrix
acceptance_criteria: The matrix identifies the roles that can read or export tickets.
verification_steps: Inspect the redacted role configuration in an authorized internal review.

actions.summary: Request the retention setting and a synthetic deletion record
actions.effort: One setting and one synthetic record
acceptance_criteria: The setting and record show when deletion takes place and what triggers it.
verification_steps: Compare the configured period with the synthetic deletion record.

actions.summary: Observe whether the script makes a network request
acceptance_criteria: The capture identifies any request the script makes and any data sent in the sampled load.
verification_steps: Load the authorized page in an isolated browser and inspect its network log without submitting a form.
